hadiths.english_translation: Yahya said: I heard Malik saying: The Sunnah among us regarding crimes committed by slaves is that whatever a slave does in terms of wounding a person, or something he snatches, or property he steals as a guard, or hanging fruit he cuts or damages, or theft he commits for which there is no amputation - all of this is upon the neck of the slave and does not exceed the neck, whether little or much. If his master wishes to give the value of what his slave took or damaged or the blood money for what he wounded, he gives it and keeps his slave. And if he wishes to hand him over, he hands him over, and there is nothing else upon him. So his master has the choice in that.

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ يَحْيَى : سَمِعْتُ مَالِكًا ، يَقُولُ : السُّنَّةُ عِنْدَنَا فِي جِنَايَةِ الْعَبِيدِ ، أَنَّ كُلَّ مَا أَصَابَ الْعَبْدُ مِنْ جُرْحٍ جَرَحَ بِهِ إِنْسَانًا ، أَوْ شَيْءٍ اخْتَلَسَهُ ، أَوْ حَرِيسَةٍ احْتَرَسَهَا ، أَوْ ثَمَرٍ مُعَلَّقٍ جَذَّهُ أَوْ أَفْسَدَهُ ، أَوْ سَرِقَةٍ سَرَقَهَا لَا قَطْعَ عَلَيْهِ فِيهَا ، إِنَّ ذَلِكَ فِي رَقَبَةِ الْعَبْدِ لَا يَعْدُو ذَلِكَ الرَّقَبَةَ قَلَّ ذَلِكَ أَوْ كَثُرَ ، فَإِنْ شَاءَ سَيِّدُهُ أَنْ يُعْطِيَ قِيمَةَ مَا أَخَذَ غُلَامُهُ أَوْ أَفْسَدَ أَوْ عَقْلَ مَا جَرَحَ أَعْطَاهُ وَأَمْسَكَ غُلَامَهُ ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ أَنْ يُسْلِمَهُ أَسْلَمَهُ وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ غَيْرُ ذَلِكَ ، فَسَيِّدُهُ فِي ذَلِكَ بِالْخِيَارِ

hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ، قَالَ : " مَنْ أَعْتَقَ شِرْكًا لَهُ فِي عَبْدٍ ، فَكَانَ لَهُ مَالٌ يَبْلُغُ ثَمَنَ الْعَبْدِ قُوِّمَ عَلَيْهِ قِيمَةَ الْعَدْلِ ، فَأَعْطَى شُرَكَاءَهُ حِصَصَهُمْ ، وَعَتَقَ عَلَيْهِ الْعَبْدُ ، وَإِلَّا فَقَدْ عَتَقَ مِنْهُ مَا عَتَقَ "

hadiths.english_translation: Malik said: Whoever frees a slave of his and makes his manumission absolute so that his testimony is valid, his freedom is complete, and his inheritance is established - his master cannot stipulate upon him what he stipulates upon his slave, neither wealth nor service, nor burden him with anything of slavery, because the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whoever frees his share in a slave, a fair value shall be assessed for him, and he shall give his partners their shares, and the slave shall be freed for him.' Malik said: So if the slave belongs to him exclusively, he has more right to complete his manumission and not mix it with anything of slavery.

hadiths.arabicText: بَابُ مَنْ أَعْتَقَ رَقِيقًا لَا يَمْلِكُ مَالًا غَيْرَهُمْ

hadiths.english_translation: It was narrated from Yahya ibn Sa'id, and from more than one person, from al-Hasan ibn Abi al-Hasan al-Basri, and from Muhammad ibn Sirin, that a man in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ freed six slaves of his at his death, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ drew lots among them and freed one-third of those slaves. Malik said: It reached me that the man had no property other than them.

hadiths.english_translation: Rabi'ah ibn Abi Abd al-Rahman narrated that a man during the governorship of Aban ibn Uthman freed all his slaves together, and he had no property other than them. So Aban ibn Uthman ordered those slaves to be divided into thirds, then he drew lots as to which third the deceased's portion would fall upon so they would be freed. The lot fell upon one of the thirds, so the third upon which the lot fell was freed.

hadiths.english_translation: Chapter: The Ruling on the Slave's Property When He is Freed
hadiths.arabicText: بَابُ الْقَضَاءِ فِي مَالِ الْعَبْدِ إِذَا عَتَقَ

hadiths.english_translation: From Ibn Shihab that he heard him saying: The Sunnah has passed that when a slave is freed, his wealth follows him. Malik said: What clarifies this - that when a slave is freed his wealth follows him - is that when a mukatab (slave buying his freedom) makes his contract, his wealth follows him even if the mukatab did not stipulate it. That is because the contract of kitabah is a contract of clientship when it is completed, and the wealth of the slave and the mukatab is not like what they had of children. Their children are in the status of their persons, not in the status of their wealth, because the Sunnah about which there is no disagreement is that when a slave is freed, his wealth follows him but his children do not follow him, and that when a mukatab makes his contract, his wealth follows him but his children do not follow him. Malik said: What also clarifies this is that if the slave and the mukatab go bankrupt, their wealth and the mothers of their children are taken, but their children are not taken, because they are not wealth for them. Malik said: What also clarifies this is that if a slave is sold and the one who bought him stipulates his wealth, his children do not enter into his wealth. Malik said: What also clarifies this is that if a slave wounds someone, he and his wealth are taken but his children are not taken.

hadiths.english_translation: Chapter: The Freeing of Mothers of Children and Comprehensive Rulings on Manumission
hadiths.arabicText: بَابُ عِتْقِ أُمَّهَاتِ الْأَوْلَادِ وَجَامِعِ الْقَضَاءِ فِي الْعَتَاقَةِ

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Umar that Umar ibn al-Khattab said: 'Any slave-woman who gives birth from her master - he shall not sell her, nor give her as a gift, nor bequeath her. He may enjoy her, and when he dies, she is free.' And it was narrated to Malik that it reached him that a slave-woman came to Umar ibn al-Khattab whose master had struck her with fire or it had afflicted her, so he freed her. Malik said: The agreed-upon matter among us is that the manumission of a man does not take effect when he has debt that encompasses his wealth, and that the manumission of a boy does not take effect until he reaches puberty or attains the age of puberty, and that the manumission of one under guardianship in his wealth does not take effect even if he reaches puberty until he manages his wealth.

hadiths.arabicText: بَابُ مَا يَجُوزُ مِنَ الْعِتْقِ فِي الرِّقَابِ الْوَاجِبَةِ

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Mu'awiyah ibn al-Hakam (the narrator's name appears as 'Umar ibn al-Hakam' in this text, though the well-known narrator of this hadith is Mu'awiyah ibn al-Hakam al-Sulami) that he said: I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, a slave-girl of mine was tending sheep for me, and I came to her when a sheep from the flock was lost. I asked her about it and she said: The wolf ate it. So I became angry with her - and I am from the children of Adam - so I slapped her face. And I have to free a neck, should I free her?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to her: 'Where is Allah?' She said: 'In the heaven.' He said: 'Who am I?' She said: 'You are the Messenger of Allah.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Free her.'

hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ هِلَالِ بْنِ أُسَامَةَ ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ، فَقُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، إِنَّ جَارِيَةً لِي كَانَتْ تَرْعَى غَنَمًا لِي ، فَجِئْتُهَا وَقَدْ فُقِدَتْ شَاةٌ مِنَ الْغَنَمِ ، فَسَأَلْتُهَا عَنْهَا ، فَقَالَتْ : أَكَلَهَا الذِّئْبُ . فَأَسِفْتُ عَلَيْهَا ، وَكُنْتُ مِنْ بَنِي آدَمَ فَلَطَمْتُ وَجْهَهَا وَعَلَيَّ رَقَبَةٌ ، أَفَأُعْتِقُهَا ؟ فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " أَيْنَ اللَّهُ ؟ " فَقَالَتْ : فِي السَّمَاءِ . فَقَالَ : " مَنْ أَنَا ؟ " فَقَالَتْ : أَنْتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ . فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " أَعْتِقْهَا "

hadiths.english_translation: From Ibn Shihab, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah ibn Mas'ud, that a man from the Ansar came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with a black slave-girl of his. He said: 'O Messenger of Allah, I must free a believing neck, and if you see her as a believer, I will free her.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to her: 'Do you testify that there is no god but Allah?' She said: 'Yes.' He said: 'Do you testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah?' She said: 'Yes.' He said: 'Do you believe with certainty in resurrection after death?' She said: 'Yes.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Free her.'

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنْ الْأَنْصَارِ جَاءَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِجَارِيَةٍ لَهُ سَوْدَاءَ ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، إِنَّ عَلَيَّ رَقَبَةً مُؤْمِنَةً ، فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَرَاهَا مُؤْمِنَةً ، أُعْتِقُهَا ؟ فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " أَتَشْهَدِينَ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ ؟ " قَالَتْ : نَعَمْ . قَالَ : " أَتَشْهَدِينَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ؟ " قَالَتْ : نَعَمْ . قَالَ : أَتُوقِنِينَ بِالْبَعْثِ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ ؟ قَالَتْ : نَعَمْ . فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " أَعْتِقْهَا "
